Focusing on the group “Ding,” it can be read that Ding's area is about 23 million hm², yield per unit area is about 2116 kg/hm², and total output is about 49.67 million t. Reasoning: Among the five candidate countries of the United States, Canada, China, Denmark, and India, Ding shows a relatively large wheat planting area, relatively low yield per unit area, and medium-high total output. This corresponds to the characteristics of India's wheat production of “large area, relatively low yield per unit area, and relatively high total output.” Therefore, Ding represents India.
